primary_sources_checked.basis: Green 1 oz 0.10 mm solder-mask web; 1.0 mm text and 0.15 mm line/pad-to-silk rules; ordinary ink plugging requires at least 0.35 mm to openings and diameter no greater than 0.5 mm.
Standard supports two-sided SMT/THT and 240 +/-5 C reflow. Actual panel/process acceptance still required.
Rev8 p9 section3.3 recommends 90-150 um stencil and 70-90% signal-pad paste area. Native U4 paste 0.5405x0.329 vs 0.575x0.350 mm is 88.36%; selected 0.10 mm stencil lies in the range.
